answer: Citation bond: an identity locks 40 credits and cites checkable records in the dune registry for each claim. A lantern audit samples 10% of citations each epoch; a signature mismatch with the claimant's key burns the bond. One fake costs 65; the k-th costs 65+8(k-1), each needing a fresh source, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,061,000 against a 40,000 nectar pool. Rented citations fail the check. An honest agent pays 40 once, citing work it already did.
